title: people-ops-recruiting-coordinator-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-07
content:
Daily scratchpad - Maya T. (people ops recruiting coordinator)
Date: 2026-03-07

Morning inbox triage (8:30-9:00)
- Check candidate replies overnight and triage to buckets: interview confirmations, reschedules, take-home submissions.
- Priority: responses from Senior ML Infra candidates (S.M. loop) and Offer approvals.

Top of mind / today
- Close loop on S.M. take-home (E.M.) - need confirmation they can submit by EOD Wed.
- Schedule final onsite for Backend candidate (C-Backend) with Liam and Priya - prefer 3/11 or 3/12.
- Prep and send offer approval packet to Jordan for Backend Sr. (comp worksheet, manager notes).
- Debrief with hiring managers for two PM interviews (12:30).

Today - time blocks
- 9:00-10:00: interview buffer, quick debriefs (walk through notes from yesterday)
- 10:00-11:00: scheduling block - coordinate interviewers for next week (use Calendly + Slack fallback)
- 11:00-11:30: follow-ups (see list below)
- 12:30-1:00: PM debrief w/ Priya (Zoom)
- 1:00-2:00: resume parsing for IC Data Eng role, shortlist 5
- 2:30-3:00: offer packet prep and send to Jordan
- 3:00-4:00: catch-up and buffer (reschedules/time zones)

Candidate follow-ups (priority order)
- E.M. (Senior ML Infra): Submitted take-home? - email sent 3/05 asking for ETA. Follow-up: send gentle reminder + ask if need extra 48h. (Action: send template reply)
- C-Backend (Backend Engineer - L4): Hiring manager (Liam) available 3/11 10-12 PST or 3/12 1-4 PST. Send availability poll to candidate today. If candidate picks 3/11, book rooms and Slack interviewers.
- K.S. (SWE Intern): Confirm coding challenge completed - if not, send last reminder and extend deadline to 3/09.
- P.M. (Product Manager): Panel feedback outstanding from 2 of 4 interviewers - ping via Slack + set 24h follow-up reminder.

Scheduling notes / logistics
- Use interview template: "Redwood interview invite - role - candidate name"; include hiring doc link + recruiter contact number.
- Reserve interview rooms in calendar for onsite loops (book virtual rooms in Zoom and reserve small conference rooms: Conf B if onsite).
- Interviewers list for Backend final: Liam Chen, Priya Desai, N. Alvarez (optional). Email them candidate packet by EOD.

Offer / approvals
- Backend Sr. comp target: $200-220k (base) + eq target 0.2-0.35% (needs manager sign-off).
- Draft offer email template: include base, bonus, equity range, start date window, relocation stipend TBD.
- Action: Send offer approval packet to Jordan Park and cc People Ops lead (Asha Patel) by 2:30pm.

Notes from yesterday (3/06)
- Good conversation with S.M. candidate; hiring manager wants technical assignment before moving to loop. Need to share assignment + rubric.
- Interviewer no-shows: PM panel had 1 late arrival - remind interviewers to block buffer time.

Reminders / housekeeping
- Update hiring doc for Backend role with candidate shortlist and latest feedback.
- Close out rejected candidates: send polite rejection templates and add notes to ATS.
- Weekly report (send Friday): draft a quick summary of interviews, offers, and time-to-fill metrics - start skeleton today.
- Check calendar for public holidays in candidate timezones (APAC) before confirming interviews.

Templates to use / links
- Interview scheduling template (Cal + Slack) - copy from last week: confluence: Scheduling SOP
- Offer template: confluence: Offer templates -> Engineering

Quick checklist (tick when done)
[ ] Follow up with E.M. on take-home
[ ] Send availability poll to C-Backend
[ ] Prep offer packet for Backend Sr. and send to Jordan
[ ] Ping PM interviewers for feedback
[ ] Shortlist 5 resumes for IC Data Eng
[ ] Update hiring doc + ATS notes

Notes to self
- Keep time blocked for scheduling - tend to underestimate time needed.
- Lean on Jordan for comp questions instead of triaging myself.
- Save copy of offer approval once sent in shared drive folder: shared_drives/people-ops/offer-approvals (TODO: upload).

End of day wrap (EOD checklist)
- Did I send all follow-ups?
- Are next-week interviews fully staffed?
- Any approvals pending overnight? If yes, escalate to Jordan.
summary: Daily scratchpad for Maya Thompson - priority follow-ups, interview scheduling, offer prep, and housekeeping for 2026-03-07.
